These data files are available (read-only; each has a header describing its columns): /tmp/data/xcom_water.txt: photon interaction coefficients of liquid water by process (coherent, incoherent, photoelectric, pair production in the nuclear and electron fields), and the total, in cm^2/g, versus photon energy in MeV; /tmp/data/estar_water.txt: electron collision, radiative and total stopping powers of liquid water in MeV cm^2/g, CSDA range in g/cm^2, radiation yield and density-effect parameter, versus electron kinetic energy in MeV.
